overall_reason: Untinted greys with a near-black #1f1f1f 'DEPLOY' button carry the card, and green, grey and red icons mark live, building and failed rows.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES passes with state colours in one role each and one primary fill; T-NEUTRALS finds two near-identical meta greys.

findings.title: Text greys are a fixed set
findings.evidence: The text roles list #9a9a9a on 4 elements and #8a8a8a on 1, about 0.05 apart in lightness, for secondary text of one kind.
findings.before: Two secondary greys one small step apart.
findings.after: One secondary grey for all metadata.
findings.why: Two nearly equal greys look like an accident rather than two levels.

strengths: State colours keep their meaning, and each state has its own icon shape.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
